svg.aria-label: Security model. Self-authorization: Ignored. Only authority can mint an AuthorizedAction. Prompt injection: Repo files, tool and test output are data. Authority can't change. Authority-shaped fields: 34 field names rejected at any depth of a proposal. Task processes: Can't grant authority, answer conflicts or start the owner API. Path escape: Filesystem and terminal are confined to the workspace. Stale permission: Every grant carries an epoch; revocation voids it at execution. Duplicate side effects: Action identity + durable ledger; unknown outcome stops retries. Unearned success: Exit 0 or a finished plan never becomes SUCCESS on its own.
